test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the area of an equilateral triangle whose each sides is 12 cm?
solution:
**Given: **

Side of equilateral triangle = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Area = (1/4) × a² × √3

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f63e28a5b80bb735e8ec05c6318e736f3b9f9ab46ddfa40556b497dbf4852a96.png] 

According to the questions,

⇒ Area = (1/4) × (12)2 × √3

⇒ Area = (1/4) × 144 × √3

⇒ Area = 36 × √3 = 36√3 cm² 

**∴ The area of an equilateral triangle will be 36√3 cm2.**
